items.title: Musk says US government may be behind slowdown of Ukraine drone speeds
items.summary: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".

items.title: Why Zelensky's meeting with Burnham matters
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham welcomed President Zelensky to Downing Street on Wednesday, as Ukraine's leader looks to shore up his European allies five years into Russia's war on Ukraine.

items.title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
items.summary: The home secretary said she would not hesitate to impose measures on other countries "refusing to co-operate".

items.title: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
items.summary: Livestreaming the execution of Nidal Hasan "will taint the honor of the military that employs it, and a nation that allows it," 72 former officers said in a letter.

items.title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments
items.summary: Reform says all of those people filmed by ITV are under investigation having resigned or been suspended.

items.title: White House defends new press secretary amid questions about her legal credentials
items.summary: Katie Zacharia does not appear to be registered to the legal bar in any state where she has lived.

items.title: Brooklyn novelty shop reeling from 'surreal' row with Kelly Clarkson over mechanical bird
items.summary: Art of Play says its staff have been threatened after the singer complained online about how she was treated.

items.title: Drop-off charges at UK airports to be reviewed after sharp increase
items.summary: Confirming the review, the government said it was "vital to ensure travel remains accessible and that passengers are treated fairly".
